title: EXCLUSIVE: Men’s Skin Care Brand Enhanse Makes Its Inaugural Move Into Brick-and-Mortar
summary: The brand, founded by fashion veteran Evangelo Bousis, is hitting Nordstrom stores nationwide.

extraction.key_fact: 남성 스킨케어 브랜드 Enhanse가 처음으로 오프라인 매장에 진출해 전국 Nordstrom 매장에 입점한다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: The brand, founded by fashion veteran Evangelo Bousis, is hitting Nordstrom stores nationwide.
